cards.card_text: Next, the Horites, the sons of Seir who were living in the land, along with their chiefs.
cards.verse_text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
cards.snippet: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer,…

cards.card_text: The Horites used to live there, but Esau's descendants drove them out and settled in their place.
cards.verse_text: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out.
cards.snippet: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them…

cards.card_text: The note says Esau's descendants took Seir from the Horites without any help from the LORD.
cards.verse_text: just as He had done for the descendants of Esau who lived in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them.
cards.snippet: …the descendants of Esau who lived in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them.
